starting_commit_message: D4-A5-R3 repair continuation lineage and end-to-end accounting

audit_defect_repaired.finding: The continuation raw-freeze gate verified the raw-freeze commit message, its direct parent (plan-freeze), committed raw plans/results, raw-plan immutability, and protected production/historical paths — but enforced no strict plan-freeze -> raw-freeze diff allowlist. A raw-freeze commit could therefore contain continuation raw results, the continuation manifest, AND a runner (or focused-test) modification, and still reach evaluator execution — a runner modification occurring after retrieval outcomes had already been exposed.
audit_defect_repaired.mechanical_confirmation: The pre-repair raw-freeze gate compared only a fixed protected-path list (src/, configs/, datasets, historical first-attempt artifacts) that does not include the runner or focused-test paths, and applied no changed-file allowlist to the plan-freeze -> raw-freeze window.
audit_defect_repaired.repair: The raw-freeze gate now enforces a strict diff allowlist: the exact plan-freeze -> raw-freeze changed-file set must be a subset of {continuation execution manifest, continuation raw paired retrieval results}. No other path is permitted. This single allowlist subsumes broad protected-path lists for the retrieval window; upstream gates (start preflight and plan-freeze gate) cover the earlier windows.
